about: The check battery's support-language text: check.<id>.question, .option.<n> and .situation.

strings.check.hear.que-necesitas.question: You hear this at the stall. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.que-necesitas.option.1: The shopkeeper asks what you need.
strings.check.hear.quieres-pan.question: You hear this at the stall. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.quieres-pan.option.1: The shopkeeper asks what you need.
strings.check.hear.quieres-pan.option.2: The shopkeeper says the river is over there.
strings.check.hear.pedir-agua.question: You hear this from a customer. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.si-por-favor.question: You hear this. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.no-gracias.question: You hear this. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.donde-esta-el-rio.question: You hear this from a traveler. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.quieres-fruta.question: A guide says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.quieres-fruta.option.1: She asks where the river is.
strings.check.hear.necesitas-madera.question: A guide says this to you at her camp. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.necesitas-madera.option.2: You need a torch and a bottle.
strings.check.hear.me-llamo.question: A guide says this when you meet. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.es-madera.question: A guide holds up a log and says this. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.es-madera.option.1: She asks if it is wood.
strings.check.hear.es-madera.option.2: She asks if you want some wood.
strings.check.hear.es-madera.option.3: She says it is a table.
strings.check.hear.de-nada.question: You say “gracias” and a guide answers like this. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.que-quieres.question: A guide says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.que-quieres.option.1: The guide asks what you want.
strings.check.hear.que-quieres.option.2: The guide asks where the river is.
strings.check.hear.tienes-fruta.question: A guide says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.tienes-fruta.option.1: The guide asks if you have a fruit.
strings.check.hear.tienes-fruta.option.2: The guide says the wood is for the torch.
strings.check.hear.tienes-fruta.option.3: The guide offers you some fruit.
strings.check.hear.que-quieren-ustedes.question: A shopkeeper says this to you and a friend. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.que-quieren-ustedes.option.1: He asks what you both want.
strings.check.hear.que-quieren-ustedes.option.3: He says goodbye to you both.
strings.check.say.pedir-agua.situation: You are at a market stall. You want water. Ask for it politely.
strings.check.say.si-por-favor.situation: The shopkeeper offers you bread. You want it.
strings.check.say.no-gracias.situation: The shopkeeper offers you bread. You don't want it. Say no politely.
strings.check.say.donde-esta-el-rio.situation: You are in a village and need to find the river. Ask a villager.
strings.check.say.si.situation: A guide holds up a log and asks if it is wood. Answer yes.
strings.check.say.no.situation: A guide holds up a log and asks if it is water. Answer no.
strings.check.say.que-es-esto.situation: A guide points at a plant you do not know. Ask her what it is.
strings.check.say.otra-vez.situation: A guide spoke too fast and you did not catch it. Ask her to say it again.
strings.check.say.mas-despacio.situation: A guide spoke too fast. Ask her to say it again more slowly.
strings.check.say.quiero-madera.situation: A guide asks what you want. You want wood. Say so.
strings.check.say.tengo-fruta.situation: A guide asks if you have a fruit. You do. Say yes and say that you have one.
strings.check.say.ella-quiere-fruta.situation: A friend asks what {npc:guide} wants. She wants fruit. Say what she wants.
strings.check.say.necesitamos-agua.situation: A friend asks what you both need. You need water. Say it for the two of you.
strings.check.hear.que-vas-a-comer.question: A villager says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.que-vas-a-comer.option.1: He asks what you are going to eat tomorrow.
strings.check.hear.que-vas-a-comer.option.2: He asks what you ate yesterday.
strings.check.hear.que-vas-a-comer.option.3: He says there is bread at the stall.
strings.check.hear.que-comiste-ayer.question: A shopkeeper says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.que-comiste-ayer.option.1: He asks what you ate yesterday.
strings.check.hear.que-comiste-ayer.option.2: He asks what you are going to eat tomorrow.
strings.check.hear.que-comiste-ayer.option.3: He says the bread is ready.
strings.check.say.voy-a-comer-pan.situation: A villager asks what you are going to eat tomorrow. You will eat bread. Say so.
strings.check.say.ayer-comi-fruta.situation: A shopkeeper asks what you ate yesterday. You ate fruit. Say so.
strings.check.hear.que-buscas.question: A fisher says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.que-buscas.option.1: He asks what you are looking for.
strings.check.hear.esta-a-la-izquierda.question: A fisher says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.esta-a-la-izquierda.option.1: The bakery is left of the tower.
strings.check.hear.esta-a-la-izquierda.option.2: The bakery is right of the tower.
strings.check.hear.esta-a-la-izquierda.option.3: The bakery is next to the river.
strings.check.hear.hay-tres-casas.question: A fisher says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.hay-tres-casas.option.1: A shop, a bakery and three houses.
strings.check.hear.hay-tres-casas.option.2: A shop, a bakery and two houses.
strings.check.hear.hay-tres-casas.option.3: There is no shop in the village.
strings.check.hear.fuiste-a-la-panaderia.questio: A fisher says this to you. What does it mean?
He asks if you went to the bakery.
He asks if you are going to the bakery.
He says the bakery is near.
strings.check.say.donde-esta-la-panaderia.situat: A fisher asks what you are looking for. You are looking for the bakery. Ask him where it is.
strings.check.say.esta-lejos.situation: Someone has told you where the smithy is. Ask if it is far.
strings.check.say.voy-a-comprar-pan.situation: A fisher asks what you are going to do at the bakery. You are going to buy bread. Say so.
strings.check.say.fui-a-la-panaderia.situation: A fisher asks if you went to the bakery. You did. Say so.
strings.check.hear.tengo-diez-panes.question: A baker says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.cuantos-panes.question: A baker says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.cuantos-panes.option.1: She asks how many loaves you want.
strings.check.hear.cuantos-panes.option.2: She asks how much the bread costs.
strings.check.hear.cuantos-panes.option.3: She asks if you have bread.
strings.check.hear.cuesta-dos-monedas.question: A baker says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.que-compraste.question: A baker says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.que-compraste.option.2: She asks what you are going to buy.
strings.check.say.quiero-dos-panes.situation: A baker asks how many loaves you want. You want two. Ask for them.
strings.check.say.cuanto-cuesta.situation: You are at a bakery and want to know the price of the bread. Ask how much it is.
strings.check.say.voy-a-buscar-madera.situation: A baker asks what you are going to do. You are going to look for wood. Say so.
strings.check.say.compre-dos-panes.situation: A baker asks what you bought. You bought two loaves. Say so.
strings.check.hear.soy-el-herrero.question: A man at a smithy says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.soy-el-herrero.option.1: He is the smith: fire and wood.
strings.check.hear.soy-el-herrero.option.2: He is the farmer: the field.
strings.check.hear.quieres-un-hacha.question: A smith says this to you. What does he need?
strings.check.hear.quieres-un-hacha.option.1: Two wood and two coins, for an axe.
strings.check.hear.que-va-a-hacer-domingo.questi: A villager asks you this. What does he want to know?
strings.check.hear.que-va-a-hacer-domingo.option: What Domingo is going to make.
strings.check.hear.ayer-trabajo-mucho.question: A villager says this about the smith. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.ayer-trabajo-mucho.option.3: Tomorrow Domingo will work a lot.
strings.check.say.como-te-llamas.situation: You meet a smith you do not know. Ask him his name.
strings.check.say.que-haces.situation: You meet a man at a smithy. Ask him what he does.
strings.check.say.va-a-hacer-un-hacha.situation: A villager asks what Domingo is going to make. Domingo is going to make an axe. Say so.
strings.check.say.hizo-un-hacha.situation: A villager asks what Domingo made. Domingo made an axe. Say so.
strings.check.hear.mis-manzanas-son-rojas.questi: A farmer shows you his apples. What are they like?
strings.check.hear.te-gusta-el-pan.question: A farmer asks you this. What does he want to know?
strings.check.hear.mis-plantas-necesitan-agua.qu: A farmer says this to you. What does he ask for?
strings.check.hear.mis-plantas-necesitan-agua.op: Water from the river for his plants, for three apples.
Wood from the forest for his field.
strings.check.hear.el-pan-es-de-luz.question: A shopkeeper says this about his bread. What does he say?
strings.check.hear.el-pan-es-de-luz.option.1: Luz made it, at the bakery.
strings.check.say.la-manzana-es-roja.situation: A farmer asks what his apple is like. It is red. Say so.
strings.check.say.me-gustan-las-manzanas.situati: A farmer asks if you like apples. You do. Say so.
strings.check.say.quiero-tres-manzanas-rojas.sit: A farmer sells red apples. Ask for three red apples.
strings.check.say.me-gusto-el-pan.situation: A farmer asks if you liked Luz's bread. You did. Say so.
